messages:
Sarah K: Postmortem follow-up from last night's outage (cloud auth + model-registry flakiness). I built a quick action list and a dependency heatmap. Need owners & realistic timelines.
Mike L: Thanks — can you paste the heatmap and short owner table here?
Sarah K: pasted inline: 
```
Heatmap: model-registry (HIGH), cloud-auth (HIGH), metrics-ingest (MED)
Primary risk vectors: token expiry storm, registry DB failover lag, auth rate-limit spikes
```
Owner table (draft): A) multi-auth fallback -> Raj P, B) registry read-replicas + failover test -> Olivia C, C) add canary routing for new model uploads -> Julia M
Raj P: I can take A. Proposed due date 2026-04-10 for initial proof-of-concept, 2026-05-01 for rollout. Need SRE help for load tests.
Olivia C: Taking B. I'll schedule a failover drill with infra next week. Tentative due 2026-04-08 for runbook + 2026-04-20 for automation.
Julia M: I’ll own C — can we scope canary routing to Dedicated only first? Want to avoid surprising hosted customers. Due 2026-04-18 for canary config.
Mike L: Sounds good. Two requests: 1) add a smoke-check to model-registry onboarding pipeline, 2) add alert thresholds for auth token storms.
Sarah K: Added to list. New items: D) onboarding smoke-check (owner: Julia M, due 2026-04-12), E) token-storm alert tuning (owner: Mike L, due 2026-04-07).
incident-bot: Reminder: please add these as tasks in the incident board -> https://redwood.internal/boards/vendor-mitigations (automated weekly reminders enabled).
Raj P: Question — for multi-auth fallback, do we want a short-circuit to an internal service or a cached token-store? I prefer cached token-store to avoid cross-provider latency.
Olivia C: Cached token-store + circuit breaker seems safest. I'll model latency/TTL tradeoffs in the drill.
Sarah K: Good. Also proposing a recurring cadence: weekly 30-min 'deps resilience' sync till items closed. Who can attend?
Mike L: I can do weekly. Recommend Tues 10am PT.
Julia M: Works for me.
Raj P: Can do alternate weeks if needed.
Sarah K: OK booked weekly Tues 10am PT starting 2026-04-05. I'll create the recurring calendar and link notes to the incident board.
Mike L: We should also log a permanent addition to the postmortem: add "dependency heatmap" section + owner rotation policy. I'll open the postmortem PR.
Sarah K: Thanks. Final ask: owners, please add a 1-paragraph test plan to the board task by EOD Friday so we can validate in the next drill. :white_check_mark:
Olivia C: Will add test plan today.
Raj P: Adding my PoC checklist now.
Julia M: Adding smoke-check tests and canary rollout steps.
Sarah K: Closing note — if any blockers (quota, infra window, security review) speak up here so we can escalate.
Mike L: Security review needed for cached token-store. I'll ping security and track in the board.
incident-bot: Action created: #4321 multi-auth-fallback (owner: Raj P)
incident-bot: Action created: #4322 registry-failover-drill (owner: Olivia C)
incident-bot: Action created: #4323 canary-routing (owner: Julia M)
Sarah K: Thanks everyone — will follow up after the first drill and post an updated heatmap. :wave:
